display: DocSpring - Generate PDFs in a Batch

NEW_1.caption: Submissions (JSON)
NEW_1.doc: A JSON list with one object per PDF (up to 50), such as [{"data": {"name": "Jane"}, "metadata": {"user_id": 1}}]. Each object can also have field_overrides, test, template_id and template_version.
NEW_1.name: submissions

NEW_2.caption: Template ID
NEW_2.doc: The template for each submission that doesn't name its own template_id. Starts with 'tpl_'.
NEW_2.name: templateId

NEW_3.caption: Template Version
NEW_3.doc: Optional. A published version such as 1.2.0 (or 1 for the latest 1.x.x), latest, or draft. Default: the latest published version (the draft when none has been published).
NEW_3.name: version

NEW_4.caption: Test Mode
NEW_4.doc: Test PDFs are free, but they include watermarks. A test API token always makes test PDFs.
NEW_4.name: test

NEW_5.caption: Metadata
NEW_5.doc: Your own data about the record, such as an ID from your app. It isn't printed on the PDF, and it's sent with webhooks.
NEW_5.name: metadata

NEW_6.caption: Make Page Images
NEW_6.doc: Also make a PNG image of each page of the PDF (up to 100 pages).
NEW_6.name: makePageImages

NEW_7.caption: Wait
NEW_7.doc: Wait up to 45 seconds for every PDF. Turn it off to return straight away.
NEW_7.name: wait
